user.title: Forecats instance
user.description: Name this instance and choose backends for activity text and image generation.

data_description.name: Label for this instance in Home Assistant (integrations list and config entry title).
data_description.activity_provider: Creates the short story of what the pets are doing today. Gemini is cloud; OpenAI-compatible, InvokeAI, and Unsloth Studio run on your network.
data_description.image_provider: Generates the pet picture from that activity plus your reference photos. Gemini (cloud), InvokeAI, or Unsloth Studio (local).

activity_credentials.title: Activity provider access
activity_credentials.description: Connection details for the activity text provider ({provider}).

data_description.gemini_api_key: API key from Google AI Studio / Gemini.
data_description.openai_base_url: Root URL of an OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, Unsloth, vLLM, …), for example `http://localhost:11434` or `http://localhost:1234/v1`.
data_description.openai_api_key: Bearer API key if the server requires one. Leave blank for Ollama/LM Studio defaults that accept any or no key.
data_description.invokeai_base_url: Root URL of your InvokeAI server, for example `http://localhost:9090`.
data_description.invokeai_api_token: Bearer token if InvokeAI authentication is enabled. Leave blank if your server allows unauthenticated local access.
data_description.unsloth_base_url: Root URL of Unsloth Studio, for example `http://localhost:8888`.
data_description.unsloth_api_key: API key from Unsloth Settings → API (`sk-unsloth-…`). Leave blank only if keyless localhost access is enabled.

activity_settings.title: Activity settings
activity_settings.description: Model and timeout for generating the daily activity text. {discovery_note}

data_description.gemini_activity_model: Text model used to invent the daily activity (for example gemini-2.0-flash).
data_description.gemini_activity_timeout: How long to wait for activity text before failing the run.
data_description.openai_activity_timeout: How long to wait for activity text before failing.
data_description.invokeai_activity_model: InvokeAI Text LLM model used to invent the daily activity.
data_description.invokeai_activity_timeout: How long to wait for InvokeAI activity text before failing.
data_description.unsloth_activity_model: Chat model id from Unsloth (`GET /v1/models`). Load the model in Studio before generating, or use auto-switch if enabled.
data_description.unsloth_activity_timeout: How long to wait for Unsloth activity text before failing.

image_credentials.title: Image provider access
image_credentials.description: Connection details for the image provider ({provider}). Skipped when it matches the activity provider.

data_description.gemini_api_key: API key from Google AI Studio / Gemini.
data_description.invokeai_base_url: Root URL of your InvokeAI server, for example `http://localhost:9090`.
data_description.invokeai_api_token: Bearer token if InvokeAI authentication is enabled. Leave blank if your server allows unauthenticated local access.
data_description.unsloth_base_url: Root URL of Unsloth Studio, for example `http://localhost:8888`.
data_description.unsloth_api_key: API key from Unsloth Settings → API (`sk-unsloth-…`). Leave blank only if keyless localhost access is enabled.

image_settings.title: Image settings
image_settings.description: Model and generation settings for the pet picture. Final display crop size is set later on the generate_pet_picture action. {discovery_note}

data_description.gemini_image_model: Image model used to generate the pet picture.
data_description.gemini_image_timeout: How long to wait for Gemini image generation before failing.
data_description.gemini_image_aspect_ratio: Shape of the generated image before Forecats crops it for your display (for example 16:9 or 1:1).
data_description.gemini_image_resolution: Gemini output detail tier: 1K (faster/cheaper), 2K, or 4K (slower/more detail). Final crop size is still set on the generate action.
data_description.invokeai_image_model: Main InvokeAI checkpoint / model used for image generation. Text encoders (T5/CLIP/Qwen3/…) and VAE are chosen automatically from installed companions matching the main model family.
data_description.invokeai_image_timeout: How long to wait for InvokeAI image generation. CPU or low-VRAM runs can need a long timeout.
data_description.invokeai_image_width: Width in pixels for the InvokeAI generation graph.
data_description.invokeai_image_height: Height in pixels for the InvokeAI generation graph.
data_description.invokeai_image_steps: Diffusion steps. More steps can improve quality but take longer.
data_description.invokeai_image_guidance: Classifier-free guidance (CFG). Higher values stick closer to the prompt; typical ranges are roughly 2–8 depending on the model.
data_description.invokeai_image_seed: Fixed seed for reproducible images. Use 0 for a random seed each run.
data_description.unsloth_image_model: Optional diffusion model path to load (for example a FLUX.2 repo id). Leave blank to use whichever model is already loaded in Studio Images. Pet refs use FLUX.2 reference mode (max 4 images).
data_description.unsloth_image_timeout: How long to wait for Unsloth image generation (includes model load if needed).
data_description.unsloth_image_width: Width in pixels for Unsloth generation.
data_description.unsloth_image_height: Height in pixels for Unsloth generation.
data_description.unsloth_image_steps: Diffusion steps. More steps can improve quality but take longer.
data_description.unsloth_image_guidance: Classifier-free guidance (CFG). Use the model's recommended value (often lower for distilled FLUX.2 Klein).
data_description.unsloth_image_seed: Fixed seed for reproducible images. Use 0 for a random seed each run.
